Name: Fire TV Remote
Author: altbryson
Description: Turns Stream Deck keys into a Fire TV remote (over ADB on the home network): arrows, select, back, home, play/pause, volume, sleep/wake, and one-press app launching.

Actions.Name: Remote key
Actions.Tooltip: A Fire TV remote button: arrows, select, back, home, play/pause, volume, sleep/wake...

Actions.Name: Open app
Actions.Tooltip: Open an app on the Fire TV (Peacock, Paramount+, Prime Video, YouTube TV...)
